card.name: Malambo
card.tagline: Competitive solo gaucho footwork duel of the Pampas.
card.profile: Malambo is a solo, traditionally all-male competitive gaucho dance from the Pampas, with no formal choreography. Dancers face off in counterpoint, displaying elaborate percussive footwork - zapateados (stomping) and cepillados (brushing) - often with spinning boleadoras and accompanied by guitar and bombo (English Wikipedia). Two main styles exist: estilo sureño (southern) and estilo norteño (northern, faster). The first musical version was published by Ventura Lynch in 1883.
card.insight: Malambo is the central solo expression of gaucho identity; the National Malambo Festival has been held in Laborde, Córdoba, since 1966, and the troupe Malevo brought it to a global audience on America's Got Talent in 2016 (English Wikipedia).
